sentences.text: Urmiornis shargensis is a valid, newly described species of bird.
This species was formally named by the researcher Zelenkov.
Fossils representing this genus have been found in Mongolia, with three recorded occurrences known to science.
The genus Urmiornis is classified as a member of the family Ergilornithidae.
Urmiornis shargensis lived during the Miocene epoch, specifically between 13.82 and 5.09 million years ago, spanning the Serravallian to Zanclean stages.
Recent research titled 'New Data on Ergilornithids (Aves: Ergilornithidae) from Central Asia' has provided fresh insights into these birds.
